name: Lotus The Food City
area: Seethanagaram, Tadepalli — south of Prakasam Barrage
signature_dish: Krishna-riverfront multi-cuisine buffet — seafood and Pan-Asian
why_it_matters: Undavalli Caves, the rock-cut monastery 8km from Vijayawada, has no restaurant at the site itself — the nearest sit-down dining is at Seethanagaram/Tadepalli on the south bank of the Krishna, about 3km away. Lotus The Food City is the most prominent: a waterfront multi-cuisine restaurant beside Prakasam Barrage with seafood, Pan-Asian and a buffet, plus a clear Krishna-river view.
insider_tip: It is a riverfront restaurant just below the barrage — a good lunch stop after the caves, with the Krishna for a view. Dinner buffet is the value option. Note this is base-labelled Tadepalli/Seethanagaram, not Undavalli village itself.
signature_address: Lotus The Food City, D.No 13-801, Seethanagaram, south side of Prakasam Barrage, Tadepalli, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522501

name: Hotel Anjaneya Vilas Restaurant
signature_dish: Excellent Andhra meals close to the caves
why_it_matters: One of the closest sit-down restaurants to Undavalli Caves, on Sivalayam Street — reviewers single it out for an excellent Andhra meal. In an area with very little dining at the cave site, it is the practical Andhra-meals option for cave visitors.
insider_tip: The Andhra meal is the order — reviewers rate it well above the restaurant's modest setting. A handy lunch stop right after the caves rather than driving back into Vijayawada.
signature_address: Hotel Anjaneya Vilas, Sivalayam Street, near Undavalli Caves, Tadepalli, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522501

name: Southern Spice (Tadepalli side)
signature_dish: Fiery Andhra curries and seafood biryani on the Krishna's south bank
why_it_matters: Southern Spice — the regional-Andhra restaurant known for traditional recipes and fiery curries — is among the better-reviewed dining options within reach of Undavalli Caves, about 3.7km away on the Tadepalli side of the Krishna. A polished sit-down option for the cave-and-barrage cluster.
insider_tip: Order the country-chicken (natu kodi) dishes — the kitchen's strength. Base-labelled Tadepalli, not Undavalli village; combine with a Prakasam Barrage stop on the way back to Vijayawada.
signature_address: Southern Spice, Tadepalli, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522501

name: Kotayya Hotel, Tadepalli
why_it_matters: A Tadepalli eatery running since 1995 — the kind of no-frills local Andhra meals house that has fed the south-bank Krishna belt for decades. For cave visitors who want a cheap, honest plate rather than a riverfront buffet, it is the everyday option near Undavalli.
insider_tip: Plain and budget — come for a fast Andhra meal, not ambience. Base-labelled Tadepalli; pairs with the cluster of Tadepalli messes and tiffin houses if Kotayya is full.
signature_address: Kotayya Hotel, Tadepalli, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522501
